item.title: Shikhar Malhotra named chairman of HCL-Foxconn chip venture as Jewar plant advances
item.summary: India Chip Private Limited, the semiconductor joint venture between HCL Group and Hon Hai Technology Group (Foxconn), has appointed Shikhar Malhotra as its chairman, according to tele.net.in. Malhotra, who also chairs HCL Capital and serves on the board of HCL Corporation, will lead the venture as it works toward commissioning its outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) facility in Jewar, Uttar Pradesh.
